exposure: Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander infants
outcome: Incidence of invasive GBS infection under 90 days of age
Risk factors for early onset GBS
Risk factors for late onset GBS
cohort: Infants born in North Queensland from January 2002 to December 2011
finding: Early onset GBS and late onset GBS have distinct risk factors, with early onset GBS associated with maternal and obstetric complications and late onset GBS associated with prematurity and other infant factors.
mod_finding: Delivery by emergency caesarean section was a risk factor for both early and late onset GBS.
